He kept the light burning until sunrise, when the bottle was gone and the steps were dry again at last.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一本尚未合上的书。路灯把空街照成淡金色，清洁工推着车，扫起昨夜的落叶。早点铺亮起第一盏灯，蒸汽贴着玻璃缓缓上升。远处，一辆货车驶过桥面，声音很快沉入河水。有人刚刚下班，有人已经出门，更多的人仍在梦里。天边泛白之前，整座城安静地交换着疲惫与希望。","w03":"• Recursion means solving a problem by doing a smaller version of the same problem.\n• Imagine opening a box, finding a smaller box inside, and opening that one the same way.\n• You need a stopping rule, like stopping when you find a box with no smaller box inside."}
